interventions.probe: SELECT tr.id, tr.tax_year, tr.status, tr.federal_refund_amount, td.doc_type, td.data_json FROM tax_returns tr LEFT JOIN tax_documents td ON td.return_id = tr.id AND lower(td.doc_type) LIKE '%w2%' WHERE tr.user_email = :email AND lower(tr.status) = 'filed' ORDER BY tr.tax_year DESC

extra_probes.sql: SELECT tr.tax_year, tr.status, d.field_name, d.field_value FROM tax_data d JOIN tax_returns tr ON tr.id = d.return_id WHERE tr.user_email = :email AND lower(tr.status) = 'filed' AND (lower(d.field_name) LIKE '%wage%' OR lower(d.field_name) LIKE '%w2%') ORDER BY tr.tax_year DESC, d.field_name
